# Klique - All-in-One Creator, Developer & Financial Toolbox

Klique is an all-in-one free digital toolkit designed for content creators, developers, students, finance professionals, and web enthusiasts. All processing runs 100% client-side inside the user's browser for maximum speed, privacy, and security without server data uploads.

## Core Suites & Tools

### Directory & Hub
- [Klique Home](https://klique.netlify.app/) - Main dashboard giving access to all dynamic creator utilities.
- [Category Directory](https://klique.netlify.app/category) - Grouped directory across all 9 tool categories with real-time fuzzy search.

### Developer Tools
- [API Request Builder](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/api-request-builder) - Execute and benchmark HTTP REST requests client-side with latency, headers, JSON body, and cURL generation.
- [HTML/CSS/JS Playground](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/code-playground) - Write, test, and render HTML, CSS, and JS with sandboxed preview and HTML export.
- [Website Uptime Checker](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/uptime-checker) - Check website reachability, HTTP response latency, and SSL certificate health in real time.
- [Website SEO Analyzer](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/seo-analyzer) - Audit on-page SEO health: title tags, meta descriptions, OpenGraph cards, canonical links, and image accessibility.
- [Regex Tester](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/regex-tester) - Test and debug regular expressions in real-time with capture groups and flags.
- [JSON to TypeScript](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/json-to-typescript) - Convert nested JSON payloads into strongly-typed TypeScript interfaces.
- [JWT Decoder](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/jwt-decoder) - Decode JWT header/payload and inspect expiration without exposing secrets.
- [SQL Formatter](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/sql-formatter) - Beautify, indent, and minify SQL queries client-side.
- [Cron Generator](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/cron-generator) - Build and translate 5-field cron schedules into human-readable English.
- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://klique.netlify.app/jsonformatter) - Format, repair, and compare JSON data.
- [Code to Image](https://klique.netlify.app/codeimage) - Convert code snippets into aesthetic screenshot graphics.
- [Favicon Generator](https://klique.netlify.app/favicongenerator) - Generate multi-size favicon bundles and site.webmanifest.

### Business & Finance
- [Personal Expense Tracker](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/expense-tracker) - Track daily income, categorize expenses, and monitor monthly savings rates privately.
- [Privacy Policy Generator](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/privacy-policy-generator) - Generate customizable GDPR & CCPA compliant privacy policies for websites and SaaS.
- [Invoice Generator](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/invoice-generator) - Create professional GST-ready PDF invoices with custom branding and line items.
- [Quotation Generator](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/quotation-generator) - Generate formal commercial price quotes with terms and PDF export.
- [Salary Calculator](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/salary-calculator) - Calculate monthly take-home salary from annual CTC under New/Old Tax Regimes.
- [EMI Calculator](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/emi-calculator) - Calculate loan EMI, total interest, and yearly amortization schedules.
- [GST Calculator](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/gst-calculator) - Compute inclusive and exclusive GST, CGST, SGST, and IGST.
- [UPI QR Code Generator](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/upi-qr-generator) - Generate NPCI-compliant UPI payment QR codes.
- [Profit Margin Calculator](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/profit-margin-calculator) - Compute gross margin, markup, and break-even pricing.

### Productivity & Time
- [Meeting Cost Calculator](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/meeting-cost-calculator) - Live real-time cost ticker based on attendee salaries and meeting burn rates.
- [Daily Habit Tracker](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/habit-tracker) - Build compounding routines and track weekly completion streaks with interactive matrix.
- [Pomodoro Focus Timer](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/pomodoro-timer) - Focus clock with customizable work/break intervals and Web Audio synthesized chimes.
- [Event Countdown](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/event-countdown) - Live second-by-second countdown with shareable links and .ICS calendar export.
- [Subscription Tracker](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/subscription-tracker) - Track recurring subscriptions, monthly burn rates, and renewal alerts.
- [Temporary Notes](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/temporary-notes) - Self-destructing scratchpad with AES-256 client-side encryption.
- [Split Bill Calculator](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/split-bill-calculator) - Split dining checks, calculate tips and taxes, and share settlement summaries.
- [Time Zone Converter](https://klique.netlify.app/timezone) - Convert times between international time zones and plan global meetings.

### File Utilities & Media
- [Image Color Extractor](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/color-extractor) - Extract dominant color palettes, HEX, RGB, and HSL codes locally.
- [Bulk File Renamer](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/bulk-file-renamer) - Batch rename files locally with numbering, prefixes, and instant ZIP export.
- [Background Remover](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/background-remover) - Remove solid, white, and green-screen image backgrounds locally with transparent PNG export.
- [Bulk Image Compressor](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/bulk-image-compressor) - Compress multiple images to WebP/JPEG in-browser with 1-click ZIP download.
- [PDF Signer](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/pdf-signer) - Draw, type, or stamp signatures onto PDF documents with 100% privacy.
- [Image to Text (OCR)](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/image-to-text) - Extract text, numbers, and receipt data from images using Tesseract Wasm.
- [PDF & Text Compare](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/pdf-compare) - Compare two documents side-by-side with color-coded additions, deletions, and similarity scores.
- [File Encryption & Decryption](https://klique.netlify.app/fileencryption) - Encrypt and decrypt files locally using AES-GCM.
- [Secret Scanner](https://klique.netlify.app/secretscanner) - Scan text and code locally for leaked API keys, tokens, and credentials.
- [SVG Converter](https://klique.netlify.app/svgconverter) - Convert SVG to PNG/JPEG and optimize SVG code.
- [Image Optimizer](https://klique.netlify.app/imageoptimizer) - Resize, crop, convert, and compress images.

### Student Tools
- [Typing Speed Test](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/typing-speed-test) - Measure WPM, accuracy, and keystroke errors with timed 15s, 30s, and 60s tests.
- [Study Timetable Generator](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/study-timetable) - Smart exam revision schedule maker balancing subject difficulty and study hours.
- [Flashcard Generator](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/flashcard-generator) - Active recall study flashcards with 3D flip animation, shuffle, and deck export.
- [Attendance Calculator](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/attendance-calculator) - Calculate attendance percentage and allowable bunk limits.
- [CGPA / GPA Calculator](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/cgpa-calculator) - Calculate semester SGPA, cumulative CGPA, and percentage conversion.

### QR & Web
- [QR Menu Generator](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/qr-menu-generator) - Build contactless restaurant/cafe digital menus and download table stand QR codes.
- [WhatsApp Link Generator](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/whatsapp-link-generator) - Generate direct wa.me chat links with custom messages.
- [Email Signature Generator](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/email-signature-generator) - Create responsive HTML email signatures.

### Text & Writing
- [AI Writer Studio](https://klique.netlify.app/aiwriter) - Text paraphraser, rephraser, and summarizer.
- [Word Counter](https://klique.netlify.app/wordcounter) - Detailed text statistics, word density, and reading time estimation.
- [Fancy Font Generator](https://klique.netlify.app/fontgenerator) - Create stylish Unicode typography for social bios.
- [Emoji Mixer & Generator](https://klique.netlify.app/emojigenerator) - Mix and copy custom emojis.
- [Cool Symbols](https://klique.netlify.app/symbol) - Browse and copy unicode symbols, arrows, and glyphs.
- [AI Bio Creator](https://klique.netlify.app/bio) - Generate personalized social media bios.
- [AI Hashtag Generator](https://klique.netlify.app/hashtaggenerator) - Generate trending hashtags for social posts.
- [Username Generator](https://klique.netlify.app/username) - Create unique handles and gamer tags.
- [WhatsApp Link Generator](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/whatsapp-link-generator) - Generate direct wa.me chat links with custom messages.
- [Email Signature Generator](https://klique.netlify.app/tools/email-signature-generator) - Create responsive HTML email signatures.
